item.title: Remembering Brian Hauser
item.description: We are deeply saddened by the passing of our colleague Brian Hauser. Brian was a valued member of the Member Support team. Vale to a colleague and friend.

item.title: Anzac Day – Saturday 25 April
item.description: Anzac Day honours those who served in wars, conflicts and peacekeeping operations. As it falls on a Saturday this year, there is no public holiday in Victoria.

item.description: Keep an eye out for details on how to book your free annual flu vaccination and skin check.

item.description: Interested in presenting the Acknowledgement of Country at a future Town Hall? Sign up via the EOI on the All Staff channel.

item.description: Shannon Lengauer, Triage Consultant in Service Investigations, finishes up on 24 April. We thank Shannon for his contributions and wish him well.

item.title: Welcome Back Nicola Beavan
item.description: Nicola Beavan, Business Analyst, returns from Parental Leave this week. Welcome back Nicola!

item.title: Reminder: Keep Walkways Clear
item.description: Chairs left in walkways are a trip hazard. Please push your chair under your desk when stepping away and keep areas around your workspace clear.

item.title: Reminder: Kitchen Tidiness
item.description: Please clean up after yourself in the kitchen every time. Forgotten or expired food will be binned each Friday.

item.title: Habitat for Humanity – Get Involved
item.description: Don't forget to sign up for the Habitat for Humanity volunteer program. Check the email for full details on how to lend a hand.

item.title: Dirty Chairs? Bring Them to Level 6
item.description: Dirty chairs can be taken to L6 Concierge for steam cleaning. Mark them with a post-it note showing where they belong (e.g. L4.11).

item.title: Wellness Corner: The Power of Focus
item.description: Focus is saying no to everything except what matters. Noise pulls your attention away; focus pulls it back.
